subject: Request: authorize temporary staffing swap for Inference Oncall backfill
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Cole <erin@hiringagency.io>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Request: authorize temporary staffing swap for Inference Oncall backfill

Hi team,

We need to open a short-term backfill for the Inference Oncall rotation. Current headcount gap is 1x (senior inference ops) for an expected ~12-week window while a permanent candidate finishes notice. Hiring manager (Vivek) and I discussed using a contractor-to-FTE pathway to keep throughput on Page and reduce incident risk.

Why now:
- Two adjacent rotations overlap Aug 24 - Sep 30, leaving net coverage short three primary oncall shifts/week.
- Candidate funnel is progressing (Erin has a strong contractor-ready candidate, Alex Romero), but they cannot start before Sept 20.

Ask:
1) Approval to open an interim requisition (contractor, 12 weeks) and start interview gating for the contractor pipeline.
2) Grant provisional hire authority up to $12,000/week (bill rate) for the duration; final comp to be reconciled with PeopleOps.
3) Greenlight for a compact interview runway: 1x screen, 1x technical panel (60m), 1x manager sync (30m) — total target calendar footprint 3 hours for the solid candidate.

Attached: req_summary.pdf (1-page justification) and jd_inference_ops.md (contractor job blurb).

If we can get a quick yes from finance/leadership today, Erin will move Alex through scheduling this afternoon.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Technical Recruiting Partner (inferred) — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: req_summary.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: jd_inference_ops.md (MD)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Cole <erin@hiringagency.io>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: authorize temporary staffing swap for Inference Oncall backfill

Thanks Monica — quick read and a few clarifying asks before I start Workday intake: 

- Please confirm headcount owner (team budget or central SRE). Who signs the PO?
- Provide the target hourly/week cap in USD (you listed a provisional weekly rate; need approval band: min/target/max).
- Confirm whether this is contractor through agency (Erin) or Redwood managed contractor. If agency, I need the agency T&C and SOW draft.

Suggested interview panel:
- 20m phone screen (Recruiter: Marissa)
- 60m technical with Vivek + Markus
- 30m manager/culture sync with Vivek

I attached the PeopleOps checklist — run through this with Erin and Megan (finance) and then I can spin the req in Workday same day.

I cc'd Erin so she can share CV+rate confirmation for Alex.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | People Ops (Recruiting Ops) — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: peopleops_checklist.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: authorize temporary staffing swap for Inference Oncall backfill

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 9:18 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We need to open a short-term backfill for the Inference Oncall rotation.

I've reviewed operational risk — we need coverage. I approve opening an interim contractor req with the following constraints: 
- Max duration 12 weeks, renewable only with documented incident risk and finance sign-off.
- Contractor must have proven low-latency system troubleshooting experience and prior GPU-inference exposure.
- Hiring manager (me) will attend the technical panel and fast-track decisions (48-hour decision SLA).

I’m comfortable with the provisional cap you proposed (up to $12,000/week) for an agency contractor; Marissa please confirm billing cadence.

Go ahead to schedule the recruiter screen. If Alex is agency-submitted, Marissa/Erin please confirm references before the panel.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Director, Inference Platform — Redwood Inference

From: Erin Cole <erin@hiringagency.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: authorize temporary staffing swap for Inference Oncall backfill

Hi all — thanks for the fast turnaround. Alex Romero (candidate) confirmed availability for an initial recruiter screen Mon Aug 16 at 10:00am PT. Quick notes and attachments below: 

- CV attached in follow-up (not included here per candidate preference).
- Proposed rate: $95/hour (not to exceed the weekly cap mentioned).
- References: two managers from prior infra roles; I will send reference emails to Marissa after the screen.

I've created a tentative interview runway and pushed calendar invites to Monica's calendar. 
[Attachment: interview_runway.ics (ICS)]

If the panel likes Alex in the technical round, we recommend an expedited 48-hour decision and offer via DocuSign.

—Erin Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter | BrightPath Talent (agency)
Erin: +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: authorize temporary staffing swap for Inference Oncall backfill — REQ created

Folks — quick update: I created the interim requisition in Workday and assigned REQ-2026-4087. Link below. Please note the following next steps:

- REQ details: contractor, 12-week duration, agency BrightPath, weekly cap set at $11,800 to give a small buffer against invoices.
- Hiring panel: recruiter screen Mon 2026-08-16 10:00 PT (Erin/Alex) -> technical panel Tue 2026-08-17 09:00 PT (Vivek + Markus) -> manager sync Tue 2026-08-17 10:15 PT.
- Marissa: I will complete the agency SOW and finalize PO this afternoon.
- Monica: please own candidate communication and ensure references are sent before the panel.

REQ link: https://workday.redwood.example.com/req/REQ-2026-4087
Attached: workday_create_receipt.pdf (internal receipt).

We are set to proceed; tagging finance for record. If you need a higher cap we will require CFO sign-off.

—Marissa
